scripts.api: uv run --package api --directory apis/api uvicorn main:app --reload
scripts.preinstall: uv sync --all-packages --group dev && uv run --directory apis/api python extract_openapi.py && bunx openapi-typescript ./apis/api/openapi.json --no-default-non-nullable -o ./schema.d.ts && cp ./schema.d.ts ./apps/front/schema.d.ts && cp ./schema.d.ts ./apps/admin/schema.d.ts
